title: Legacy UI Automation for Enterprise Data Migration
business: Enterprise IT departments managing legacy software systems that lack modern APIs.
problem: High operational costs and human error associated with manually transcribing data from legacy desktop applications into modern cloud-based CRM systems.
solution: Utilizing the Gemini 2.5 computer use preview 10 2025 model to visually interpret the legacy application interface and autonomously execute UI interactions like clicking and typing to facilitate data migration.
steps: Identify the specific legacy desktop application windows and UI elements required for the migration workflow.
Configure the Gemini 2.5 computer use preview 10 2025 environment to establish a secure, isolated connection to the host machine.
Define the sequence of UI actions including navigation, data extraction from legacy fields, and input into the target system.
Monitor the autonomous agent execution to ensure UI elements are correctly identified and interactions are performed as expected.
Validate the migrated data against the source records to ensure integrity.
outcome: Automated, reliable data transfer from legacy systems without the need for custom API development or manual intervention.
limitation: The model is deprecated and will be shut down soon; users must monitor for service interruptions and plan for migration to alternative agentic workflows.
